page.notes: The marginal note at the right is set in italic and partly hard to read; its wording "Sententiæ lau-dationum p-bantur." is reconstructed from the visible fragments and is doubtful. The word "ere-cto" at the line end is doubtful: the printed form after the hyphen is partly obscured.
